example.title: Fishermen's Terminal main building (rebuilt 1988), Salmon Bay
example.place: Fishermen's Terminal, Seattle, King County, WA

brief: The 1988 terminal building of a working fishing harbour: a long two-storey shed of grey corrugated metal with a low gable roof, a continuous band of big multipane windows along the upper floor, a ground-floor arcade of shops and a fish market, and a big lettered sign frame on the roof; fishing boats moored along the floating docks in front. Three photos. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
